skills.description: Build or adopt an issue-to-release delivery workflow for an app. Use when starting a project, integrating an existing repository, or resuming a delivery task with App Launchpad. Do not use for standalone incident queries or unrelated code changes.

Plan, implement and verify Dynatrace browser RUM, OpenTelemetry, business events and delivery telemetry. Use when instrumenting an app, service, worker or CI workflow. Do not use for routine telemetry investigation without instrumentation changes.
Design product journeys, interfaces and service contracts. Use when defining the behavior, states or acceptance criteria of a change. Do not use for a delivery-only task.
Implement agreed application changes using affected service contracts. Use when changing code in an App Launchpad project. Do not use for release-only or planning-only work.
Choose and run risk-based checks for project and service changes. Use when verifying a candidate or reproducing a behavior in a controlled test. Do not use to approve production promotion.
Prepare, execute and verify authorized releases and rollback. Use when publishing, deploying or restoring a checked App Launchpad candidate. Do not use for ordinary feature implementation.
Maintain Dynatrace runtime and delivery instrumentation. Use when adding or verifying signals for a project change. Do not use for standalone exploratory queries.
Record or resume App Launchpad work from verified source and evidence. Use when handing off a task or restoring its current state. Do not use as a substitute for release verification.
Maintain template validators, service registration and opt-in ruleset tooling. Use when changing or diagnosing the App Launchpad foundation scripts or CI. Do not use for product features.

Generate Ian-style English article illustrations. Use when the user or project has selected the Ian Xiaohei style for an English article, guide or explainer. Default to the Xiaohei IP, pure white hand-drawn look, sparse red/orange/blue annotations, and a clean but imaginative visual style. Do not use for generic illustration, PPT, commercial brand art, children's cartoons, or non-Xiaohei image requests unless the user explicitly asks for Ian/Xiaohei style.
Update project docs from actual behavior and decisions. Use when writing or verifying changed delivery, product or developer guides. Do not use for source implementation.
